# [PLATFORM] Delivery Services — Terms & Conditions

**Effective date:** [DATE]

These Terms & Conditions ("**Terms**") govern the delivery services made
available by [COMPANY] ("**we**", "**us**", "**the Platform**") to the business
or person using them ("**you**", "**the Client**"). By booking a delivery
through the Platform you agree to these Terms in full.

---

## 1. The two delivery services

**1.1 Last-Mile Delivery.** Deliveries performed within a delivery zone by
drivers connected to the Platform's own delivery network. Last-Mile Delivery is
governed by these Terms excluding Part B.

**1.2 Intercity Delivery (city-to-city).** Deliveries performed by independent
third-party logistics providers, couriers and carriers integrated into the
Platform ("**Logistics Providers**"). Intercity Delivery is governed by these
Terms including Part B.

**1.3 We are a technology platform.** For Intercity Delivery we act solely as a
technology platform, facilitator and intermediary. We are not a carrier,
courier, freight forwarder, warehouse operator or logistics service provider.
All physical collection, transportation, delivery, return, storage and claims
handling for Intercity Delivery is performed by Logistics Providers and their
subcontractors. <!-- upstream: ShipRazor preamble & Annexure A 1.2 -->

## 3. Booking information and addresses

3.1 For every parcel you warrant the accuracy of: collection address, delivery
address, sender details, recipient details, recipient contact number and email,
parcel description, **declared value**, packaging dimensions, actual weight and
any special handling requirements. Any additional charge arising from
incorrect information is for your account. <!-- upstream: Annexure A 2.3 -->

3.2 **Address registration authority.** You authorise us to register, update
and deregister your collection and delivery addresses (including registering a
collection address as a pickup location or "warehouse" in a Logistics
Provider's systems) as needed to fulfil, track and close out your bookings, and
to remove such records when no longer needed.

3.3 Charges are calculated on the greater of actual or volumetric weight.
Logistics Providers may re-weigh and re-measure parcels; where a discrepancy is
found we may adjust the charge and debit your wallet or account for the
difference. <!-- upstream: Annexure A 2.5 -->

## 4. Prohibited and restricted items

4.1 You may not ship anything that the Platform, the selected Logistics
Provider, or applicable law prohibits or restricts. **Any item a Logistics
Provider prohibits or restricts is automatically prohibited or restricted under
these Terms for parcels routed through that provider.** Without limitation,
the following are prohibited for Intercity Delivery:
<!-- upstream: Annexure B, mirrored in full -->

**Dangerous goods:** oil-based paints and thinners; industrial solvents;
insecticides and garden chemicals; lithium batteries; magnetized materials;
machinery containing (or that has contained) fuel; camping/lantern/torch fuel;
automobile batteries; infectious substances; toxic or infectious compounds,
liquids or gases; bleach; flammable adhesives; arms, ammunition or bladed
weapons (including air guns, flares, gunpowder, fireworks, knives, swords,
antique weaponry); dry ice; aerosols, liquids or powders classified as
dangerous goods for air transport; tobacco and tobacco products; electronic
cigarettes; ketamine.

**Restricted items:** precious stones, gems, jewellery and bullion; bearer
instruments, currency and coins; poison; alcohol; firearms, explosives and
military equipment; hazardous and radioactive material; foodstuffs and liquor;
pornographic material; hazardous chemical items; plants and plant products;
drugs and medicines (including contraband and counterfeit drugs); CBD
products; vapes; counterfeit goods; live plants; cash; livestock, human or
animal remains, embryos, organs or body parts.

4.2 **Counterfeit and fraud — zero tolerance.** If we or a Logistics Provider
reasonably believe that you or your customer are shipping counterfeit, fraudulent,
cloned, pirated or misrepresented goods, we may (without limiting any other
right): seize the parcel; report the incident to authorities; blacklist you
and/or your customer; recover from you all resulting losses, damages, legal,
investigation and administrative costs; require a security deposit; block,
retain or set off COD amounts; retain and after 30 days dispose of goods in
transit; and forfeit any security deposit held. <!-- upstream: Annexure B -->

4.3 We and any Logistics Provider may inspect parcels, and may refuse,
suspend, return or otherwise deal with any parcel that is unlawful, dangerous,
prohibited, inadequately packaged or that exposes us or any third party to
legal, regulatory, financial, operational or reputational risk.
<!-- upstream: 21.2, Annexure B -->

## 5. Packaging

5.1 You are solely responsible for packaging every parcel to withstand
multi-point handling, sorting, stacking, vibration and transport by road, air
or sea: rigid outer packaging; securely sealed openings; adequate internal
cushioning; fragile items individually wrapped and marked "Fragile"; liquids
sealed with secondary containment; sharp items secured; every parcel in a
multi-parcel consignment individually labelled; waybills and labels visible and
scannable on top of the packaging. <!-- upstream: Annexure A 2.4 -->

5.2 Collection may be refused where packaging does not comply. We or the
Logistics Provider may require photographic proof of packaging for any claim,
and inadequate packaging voids any claim.

## 6. Fees, wallet and payment

6.1 You will pay the delivery fees, optional cover fees, platform fees and any
surcharges shown at booking or arising during carriage, including: fuel,
remote-area, oversize, address-correction, customs, storage, re-weigh,
re-delivery, failed-collection and return-to-origin charges.
<!-- upstream: 2.1, Annexure A 4 -->

6.2 Fees for Intercity Delivery become payable on collection of the parcel (or
initiation of a return), whether or not yet invoiced. Your wallet balance must
be positive and sufficient at all times; bookings may be refused or suspended
while it is not. <!-- upstream: 2.11, 2.15 -->

6.3 We may set off any amount you owe us against your wallet balance, COD
amounts held for you, or any other amount due to you. Overdue amounts bear
interest at Prime + 2%, calculated daily and compounded monthly.
<!-- upstream: 2.11 -->

6.4 Invoice disputes must be raised in writing within **5 (five) days** of the
invoice date, identifying the disputed amount with supporting documentation;
otherwise the invoice is final and binding. Undisputed amounts are payable
within the stated payment terms. <!-- upstream: 2.10 (7 days) — 2-day margin -->

6.5 Wallet credit not used for 3 (three) years from your last booking may be
forfeited. Refunds of wallet credit are made only to the original payment
source, subject to KYC verification. <!-- upstream: Annexure A 5.4–5.5 -->

6.6 If any payment is reversed, disputed or charged back, we may recover the
amount from you, suspend your account, and/or deduct it from COD remittances
or your wallet. <!-- upstream: 2.18 -->

## 7. Cash on delivery (COD)

7.1 Where COD is offered, the Logistics Provider collects payment from the
recipient as per the shipping label and remits it through the chain to us; we
remit it to you after deducting any fees, charges or other amounts you owe.
You appoint us as your agent solely for COD collection; we take no title to
the goods. <!-- upstream: 2.14 -->

7.2 COD amounts are remitted to you only after they have been received by us
from the Logistics Provider. We are not liable for COD lost through forcible
snatching or fraud by the recipient; such incidents are yours to pursue.
<!-- upstream: 3.6 -->

7.3 If your recipient raises a dispute, you must resolve it within **12
(twelve) hours**; failing which COD remittances may be held until it is
resolved. <!-- upstream: 3.7 (24 hours) — 12-hour margin -->

8.1 You warrant that all personal information you upload (including your

## Part B — Additional terms for Intercity Delivery

## 11. The Logistics Provider relationship

11.1 When you book an Intercity Delivery, the physical service is performed by
the Logistics Provider allocated or selected for that parcel, subject to that
provider's own terms, conditions, service levels, exclusions, liability limits,
prohibited-goods rules and claims procedures, **which apply to your parcel and
which you accept by booking**. We will identify the allocated provider on
request and make its terms available where the provider publishes them.
<!-- upstream: Annexure A 1.3, 2.6 -->

11.2 We do not guarantee the performance of any Logistics Provider and are not
liable for its acts, omissions, negligence, delays or service failures.
<!-- upstream: 3.8, 21.7 -->

11.3 Delivery timeframes are estimates only, not guarantees.

## 12. Liability for Intercity parcels — the back-to-back cap

12.1 **Our liability for any Intercity parcel (including loss, damage, theft
or non-delivery) shall never exceed the LOWEST of:**

  (a) **the amount we actually recover from the Logistics Provider (or under
      optional transit cover taken for that parcel) in respect of the claim;**

  (b) the declared value of the parcel;

  (c) the optional transit cover limit, where cover was taken; and

  (d) **R5,000 (five thousand Rand) per parcel.**
<!-- upstream: 3.3 — cap mirrored; (a) added so downstream never exceeds upstream recovery -->

12.2 Where no declared value was provided, the declared value is deemed to be
R0 and no claim is payable. Compensation for any admitted claim is limited to
the parcel's declared value and never includes the delivery fee, loss of
profit or consequential loss.

12.3 **Optional transit cover.** You may purchase optional transit cover
(where offered) for an additional fee. Cover is provided on a pass-through
basis on the terms of the applicable provider's cover product (e.g. the
Logistics Provider's transfer-of-risk product), and any claim is assessed and
paid strictly in accordance with those terms. Parcels shipped without cover
travel entirely at your risk beyond clause 12.1. <!-- upstream: 20 -->

12.4 A claim is payable to you only after, and only to the extent that, the
corresponding claim has been admitted and paid by the Logistics Provider or
cover provider. We will pursue upstream claims in good faith on your behalf
but do not guarantee their outcome.

## 13. Claims — deadlines and evidence

13.1 **Failed or disputed collection ("picked up but not connected") claims**
must be submitted within **48 (forty-eight) hours of collection** and must
include: the signed collection manifest, a photograph of the parcel, and video
footage of the collection vehicle picking up the parcel. Claims without the
signed manifest are invalid. <!-- upstream: 2.13 (3 days) — 1-day margin -->

13.2 **Damage claims** must be submitted within **48 (forty-eight) hours of
delivery**, with photographs of the outer packaging, inner packaging and
damaged goods, and photographic proof of compliant packaging.

13.3 Claims submitted after these deadlines, or with incomplete evidence, are
invalid and are waived. Time-bars and evidence requirements exist because the
upstream Logistics Provider imposes equivalent (or stricter) requirements on
us; a claim we cannot lodge upstream in time cannot be honoured downstream.

## 14. Collection, returns and surcharges

14.1 You must ensure the parcel is available, packaged and labelled at the
booked collection address at the booked time, and must verify the collection
manifest before signing. Failed-collection fees apply where the parcel is
unavailable, the address is incorrect, or collection cannot reasonably be
completed. <!-- upstream: Annexure A 2.7 -->

14.2 A parcel may be returned to origin where delivery is refused, cannot be
completed, the recipient cannot be contacted, or the address is incorrect.
Return and re-delivery charges are for your account. <!-- upstream: Annexure A 3, 21.3 -->

## 15. International parcels

Where international service is offered: no proof of delivery is provided and
the final tracking status is terminal; no returns are available and
undelivered parcels may be destroyed after the provider's cut-off; delivery
may be completed to a mailbox, porch or pickup point and closed as delivered;
COD is not available; all carriage is subject to the Selected Service
Provider's international terms; you warrant your parcels breach no sanctions,
export-control or trade-restriction laws; and all customs, duties, airport
fees and surcharges are for your account. <!-- upstream: Annexure C -->
